```yaml
name: Kani Verification

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        
      - name: Install Kani
        run: |
          cargo install kani-verifier --version 1.23.0
          
      - name: Run Kani verification
        run: |
          cd storage
          kani --features kani .
```
